issue_context.title: Parcel 2: PostHTML Transform
issue_context.body:
Create the `@parcel/transform-posthtml` package in `packages/transforms/posthtml`. This package is a Parcel 2 transform plugin for PostHTML. It will be based on the `posthtml` transform in `HTMLAsset` from Parcel 1, split into its own package.

The `@parcel/transform-posthtml` package is responsible for the following things:

* Loading `.posthtmlrc` files
* Parsing and transforming if needed
comments: This can be moved to closed, right?

review_comments: we should skip parsing altogether if there is no config.
doesn't look like this needs to be async right?
`asset.addConnectedFile` returns a promise, so I thought they needed to be awaited.
oh you're right. I forgot about that.
I wasn't happy to skip these, but I wasn't sure the new way to do this.
Yeah I think you'd have to look for a `connected_file` node in the asset graph, but that is not exposed by Parcel. cc. @wbinnssmith any ideas?
There hasn't been a real usecase for it yet, but I'm okay exposing `getConnectedFiles()` on the public Asset object.
Nice! I will look into exposing that in a different PR. It will be good exposure into areas outside of the transformer.
I did update the posthtml transformer to include dependencies so that `getConnectedFile` can be eventually used.

I took this whole file from #3037, just had to add this line in case the config had a require statement. As @wbinnssmith mentioned, we could find a common place for this to live. Until then I duplicated it.
